description: A creator disconnects after a rendered edit in a live private Grid playtest. They authenticate on a fresh ENet connection and rejoin the Room. They verify the draft snapshot and receive a host edit made during transfer before regaining creator authority. Their next edit renders in the original playtest epoch. The ordinary peer stays in the Room without receiving private gameplay or draft traffic.
